### *Molecular Biology of the Cell*, 7th Edition (2022)

**Full Author List:**
1. Bruce Alberts
2. Rebecca Heald *(new to the 7th edition)*
3. Alexander Johnson
4. David Morgan
5. Martin Raff
6. Keith Roberts
7. Peter Walter

**Publisher:** W. W. Norton & Company
**ISBN:** 978-0-393-88423-5

---

A notable change in this edition is the addition of **Rebecca Heald** as a co-author, replacing the late Dennis Bray. The 7th edition also incorporates advances in cryo-electron microscopy, single-molecule techniques, and genome editing (e.g., CRISPR), keeping it current for graduate-level coursework.

- Go to: [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK21054/](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK21054/)

### 2. 📘 W. W. Norton (Publisher — Table of Contents + Instructor Access)
- Visit: [https://wwnorton.com](https://wwnorton.com) and search the 7th edition

### 3. 🔍 Google Books Preview
- Search ISBN **978-0-393-88423-5** on [books.google.com](https://books.google.com)
